    {"start": "00:26", "end": "00:30", "speech": "And for this reason, use this sparingly. Only when the user can't continue without addressing the issue."},

    {"start": "00:41", "end": "00:44", "speech": "If you're going to block the user, you have to give them a way forward."},
    {"start": "00:44", "end": "00:49", "speech": "In-line errors show up right next to the thing that went wrong. As a general rule, the closer your error is to your issue, the better."},
    {"start": "00:49", "end": "00:53", "speech": "So these are the ones that you'll probably use most often."},
